plan.archetype: Efficient attacks transitioning into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish reliable damage and upgraded defense. Bring strong potions, maintain Weak, and discard or play Beckons before their end-turn life loss.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then add supported poison scaling and dexterity. Keep the deck focused. Fight elites with adequate health and potions; upgrade core cards when healing is unnecessary.

plan.archetype: Efficient AoE into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Recover substantial HP, add sustained damage and stronger defense, preserve useful potions, and discard or play Beckons before ending turns.
plan.summary: Heal immediately. The first elite is unavoidable; avoid additional elites and retain the shop route. Add efficient damage before speculative engines, then establish poison and dexterity. Save potions for dangerous fights.
